answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens for three epochs and must finish one checked task, like pricing a crate of quartz, captioning a glacier photo, or tracing a spiral sketch, before its votes count. Fifty fakes cost 25,000 tokens frozen plus fifty tasks and three epochs of waiting. Splitting funds across fresh wallets does not help, because bonds funded from one source are pooled and counted as one voter. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back in full when it unlocks.
